header.sector: AI accelerators, GPUs, custom silicon and their direct supply chain
header.title: Trainium3's native PyTorch training stack broadens adoption, aiding AWS custom silicon

s01_bottom_line.text: Amazon has made a major course correction toward a first-class native PyTorch (TorchNeuron) experience on Trainium3, which the publisher's hands-on testing found promising (23.89%/30.47% MFU on Qwen3-32B, 93% FlexAttention pass rate, SOTA profiler), though still far from CUDA maturity.
The publisher believes the software course correction will meaningfully broaden Trainium3 adoption into training.

⟨update 2026-11-05 · SemiAnalysis⟩ SemiAnalysis's own AgentX benchmarks show TPUv7 Ironwood delivering competitive or superior tokens-per-dollar versus NVIDIA GB300/B200/B300 and AMD MI355X on FP8 across four models, winning external TPU inference customers (Oracle, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta).

s01_bottom_line.text: Amazon has made a major course correction toward a first-class native PyTorch (TorchNeuron) experience on Trainium3, which the publisher's hands-on testing found promising (23.89%/30.47% MFU on Qwen3-32B, 93% FlexAttention pass rate, SOTA profiler), though still far from CUDA maturity.

review_warnings.s01.0: The cited spans support MFU figures, 93% FlexAttention pass rate, SOTA profiler, and 'nowhere close to CUDA maturity.' But '30.47% MFU on Qwen3-32B' and '93% FlexAttention pass rate' — the 93% span (89/96 test cases) is not tied to FlexAttention in its cited span; FlexAttention pass rate is not explicitly supported by cited spans. The MFU figures come from Qwen3-32B training per cited span C-a0502962445309, so that part holds.
review_warnings.s01.2: The cited spans support the tokens-per-dollar comparisons and the Oracle/OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta customers, but 'across four models' and 'winning external TPU inference customers' are not clearly tied to the customer span. The label MEASURED OBSERVATION is acceptable as the weakest among cited figures.
review_warnings.s02.3: The cited C-0ebc2279393608 supports 'up to 50% better performance per dollar than B200 and B300.' But the 'FP8 on Qwen 3.5 397B single-turn' scoping is only loosely supported by C-049146e4b952f9 (Qwen3.5 397B FP8). The label SOURCE OPINION is weakest cited and fine.
